spans.s: (I)--one of the three sons of शतजित् (Sataji- म्। प्।) and father of Dharma. (Dharmanetra-म्। प्।). (Dharmatantra-वा। प्।). भा. IX. २३. २१, २२; Br. III. ६९. 4. M. ४३. 8-9; वा. ९४. 4; Vi. IV. ११. 7-8.
(II)--(Arjuna s.v.); lost his kingdom through pride of power. भा. X. ७३. २०.

(I)--attained योग through the grace of Datta; were defeated by Sagara and destroyed by परशुराम;
